messages:
mike: Heads-up 1: planned cross-region read-replica failover rehearsal tonight 23:30 UTC. Aim: exercise replica promotion, routing failover, KV restore, and client retry behavior. Window ~60m. Low impact expected but prep accordingly.

sara: Quick context: this is a rehearsal only (no DB schema changes). We'll promote a read-replica in eu-west to primary for 10m then fail back. We'll also flip traffic routing for half of us-east subnets to eu-west for 15m.

nisha: Canary plan: 22:55 small traffic-shaper to 2% of production traffic, synthetic mix of short-gen + long chat. I'll run KV restore smoke at 23:10.

mike: Runbook highlights:
```
- 23:00 pause any long-running background syncs
- 23:10 run KV restore smoke and ingest small dataset
- 23:25 start 2% canary to eu-west
- 23:30 promote replica->primary (eu-west)
- 23:40 observe for 10m (5xx rate, p95, model-kv-hit)
- 23:50 revert promotion and routing
- 23:55 validate caches restored
```

sara: SLO adjustment: inference p99 latency SLO will be temporarily widened from 99.9% to 99.7% for the window (annotation will be added to SLO system). No customer-facing maintenance page; ops only.

infra-bot: maintenance created: id mnt-1792, start 1786123800, end 1786127400 — /maint mnt-1792

nisha: Monitoring to watch: `replica-promotion-time`, `db-replica-lag`, `edge-retry-rate`, `model-kv-cache-hit`. I added a short-term alert: page if 5xx > 0.8% for 5m.

mike: Cost note: expect slight token cost increase due to lower batching while traffic shifts. Estimate +2-4% for duration.

sara: If you own a service that pins region endpoints, please confirm it gracefully retries across regions.

nisha: Commands I'll run for smoke KV restore:
```
# from staging-scripts repo
./restore-kv.sh --target eu-west --small --verify
```

infra-bot: reminder: oncall rotation: @mike is primary, @nisha is secondary for 23:00-01:00 UTC

mike: I'll be on pager and in thread. Ping me directly for escalations. I'll also post a short template for the rehearsal notes/postmortem here after.

sara: ack

nisha: ack

mike: Starting prechecks at 23:05, will update with first metrics once canary is live.
